## PR 208

**Rules engine: conditions, actions, priority, active window**

**বাংলায়:** দোকানের সব নিয়মের ইঞ্জিন: ডেলিভারি, এক্সচেঞ্জ, সেট, ছাড়, উৎসব — সব নিয়ম এক জায়গা থেকে চলে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-20
  - Build status row: rules engine `@extas/rules`: one rule = kind (delivery · exchange · setTier · discount · festive · payment · policy · fulfilment), typed params (int, money, percent, hours, text, datetime, bool), scope (applies to / except), conditions, actions, priority, stackable, active window and status (DRAFT · ACTIVE · PAUSED · ENDED); `evaluate` / `quote` is pure and deterministic, a broken rule is skipped and reported, never guessed; nothing deleted (rules archived, every version kept); jobs `rules.endExpired`, `rules.checkConflicts` for the BullMQ worker; schema: SmartRule draft / params / scope / text / placements / owner-OK columns (migration `0003_smart_rules`); permissions `rules.read`, `rules.write`, `rules.publish`, `rules.approve`; settings registry v13 (`packages/settings/src/registry-rules.ts`, 16 keys); CLI `rules sample` loads 7 made-up sample rules and 3 notices, money rules as drafts
  - GitHub pull request #19, 20 Oct
- **What it does (original scope):** Rules engine: conditions, actions, priority, active window
- **Filed under:** [S10 · Smart Rules — PR 208–219](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s10--smart-rules--pr-208219)

  - Code and files: `@extas/rules`, `packages/settings/src/registry-rules.ts`
  - Settings and named keys: `rules.endExpired`, `rules.checkConflicts`, `rules.read`, `rules.write`, `rules.publish`, `rules.approve`
  - Names in the code: `evaluate`, `quote`, `0003_smart_rules`, `rules sample`
